recipe.variant: Anima Base v1.0 as the official template ships it (turbo switch off): 30 steps, cfg 4, euler/simple, 1024x1024

unet_name.note: the Anima diffusion model: Comfy Cloud has anima-base-v1.0, anima-preview3-base, anima-preview2 and anima-preview (diffusion_models). A Civitai Anima version Cloud lacks (aesthetic-v1.x, turbo-v1.x) comes in the stage's `models` with folder diffusion_models, base 'Anima'

prompt.note: Danbooru tags (lowercase, spaces not underscores), natural language, or both; tag order: quality/meta/year/safety, 1girl/1boy, character, series, @artist, general tags

sampler.note: the sampling method (ComfyUI's sampler list: euler, er_sde, euler_ancestral, dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu, …)

scheduler.note: the noise schedule (simple, normal, karras, beta, beta57, …)

width.note: the card: 'Works at resolutions between 512^2 and 1536^2 pixels'; the template rounds to multiples of 16

recipe.defaults_note: The template's subgraph flattened with its 'turbo' PrimitiveBoolean at false: the ComfySwitchNodes pick UNETLoader -> KSampler directly, steps 30 and cfg 4 (the PrimitiveInt/PrimitiveFloat 'off' values); the outer ResolutionSelector (1:1, 1.0 MP, multiple 16) gives the subgraph's own 1024x1024. Seed, prompt and negative are the template's. Only the SaveImage prefix differs ('Anima' in the template). The Base 1.0 blueprint (text_to_image_anima_base_1_0) runs the same model with er_sde/simple, 30 steps, cfg 4.
